text:
- **Codex integration for pm:** The pm service now queues replies into a live Codex session. Design pages now record the Codex parity state. Work on the owner-request judge and the day summary for Codex has started.
- **Code and test quality:** The pull request check list now names only top-level tests. A check rejects any test name that matches no top-level test. Complexity counts now separate production code from test code. A new page shows code and test metrics with trend figures.
- **Public site access:** The pm service serves pm.yeeefs.com only with a valid Cloudflare Access token. The service fails closed when the key is missing or cannot be fetched. The owner logged in through Access and confirmed that the site loads.
- **Website install links:** The install commands and the install pill now point at the latest release. They stay current after each release. The owner reviewed and merged the change.
